metadata.name: PiCrawler — Whole-Body Posture Vocabulary (Phase 8 A1)
metadata.description:
Phase 8 Rung A1 — action-vocabulary test.  Replaces the 12 independent per-servo Premotors of the_picrawler_stand_target_per_servo_compass.json with ONE whole-body multi-channel Premotor (premotor_body) that selects among K=8 COORDINATED whole-body postures.  Each posture is a 12-D joint-target row (in [-1,+1] brain-command units, same as the per-servo Premotors emit).  This isolates the hypothesis: does a coordinated (discrete, whole-body) action space lift max_distance vs per-servo continuous?  (Phase 7 closed: per-servo accel cannot be shaped into coordinated translation by any reward — da_mean climbs while distance falls.)

Vocabulary is hand-SEEDED here (A1 is seed-only by nature — a static posture is not a temporal motif to crystallize); the hybrid seed→crystallize source lands at Rung A2 (temporal gait options).  Vocabulary is ANCHORED on the body's real tall-stand pose: the baseline learns to stand at chassis_y~0.09-0.11 with u_hip2~+0.65 (legs extended downward to lift the chassis) — NOT the all-zeros rest pose (which sits at y~0.023, below FAIL_HEIGHT).  The 8 postures (u in [-1,+1]): 0=STAND_TALL (hip2=0.7,knee=0.3), 1=crouch (hip2=0.3), 2=stand_wide (+hip1 splay), 3=push_drive (hip2=0.9,knee=0.4), 4=trotA (FL+RR lifted hip2=0.2 / FR+RL planted hip2=0.8), 5=trotB (mirror), 6=front_lift (front lifted / rear planted), 7=rear_lift (mirror).  LR-symmetric as a SET: 0/1/2/3 within-posture symmetric; trotA/trotB and front_lift/rear_lift are mirror PAIRS (a gait needs LR/AP-asymmetric instantaneous postures whose mirror is also in the set).  'Lift a leg' = reduce its hip2 (less downward push → foot rises while planted legs support).  hip1=+1 means 'splay outward' for all legs (body applies HIP1_SPLAY_OUT_SIGN).

All non-topology params identical to the per-servo baseline (MC-REINFORCE, mc_lr=0.05, gamma=0.99, advantage_normalization) so the ONLY variable is action-space topology.  use_weighted_accel=false → emit the chosen posture, not a blend (blending defeats discreteness).  No reward shaping; clean distance curriculum.
